# SEZA POS

> SEZA POS is a modern cloud point-of-sale platform for convenience stores, mini marts, liquor stores, and independent retailers. Fast checkout, real-time inventory, employee time tracking, and reporting — all in a browser.

SEZA POS is built and operated by SEZA TECHNOLOGIES. Payments are handled by Paddle as Merchant of Record. New customers get a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, feature highlights, and free-trial signup.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Starter, Pro, and Business plan pricing and feature comparison.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a merchant account and start the 14-day free trial.
- [Sign in](/auth): Existing merchants and employees sign in here.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): SEZA TECHNOLOGIES terms of service.
- [Privacy Notice](/privacy): How SEZA TECHNOLOGIES collects, uses, and protects personal data.
- [Refund Policy](/refund): 30-day money-back guarantee and refund process via Paddle.
